outlook_open_inbox.description: Open the inbox for the active personal Outlook account.

outlook_list_messages.description: List structured summaries from the current Outlook message list.

limit.description: Maximum messages from 1 to 100; defaults to 20.

returns.description: Message summaries with id, sender, subject, preview, date, and unread state.

outlook_search.description: Search personal Outlook and return message summaries.

limit.description: Maximum messages from 1 to 100; defaults to 20.

outlook_read_message.description: Open and read an Outlook message from the current list.

id.description: Message id returned by listOutlookMessages or searchOutlook.

returns.description: Message sender, subject, date, and plain text.

outlook_create_draft.description: Create and auto-save a personal Outlook draft without sending it.

to.description: Recipient email string or array of email strings.

cc.description: Optional Cc contact email string or array.

bcc.description: Optional Bcc contact email string or array.

body.description: Plain-text draft body; may be empty.

returns.description: Verified draft fields and drafted status; no message is sent.
